chunks: And Ibn al-Mughīrah narrated from ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
That ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام had a servant girl who would slaughter for him whenever he wished.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the reported source of the narration
key_terms.جَارِيَةٌ: a servant girl or bondwoman in his household
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ: a narrator in the sanad transmitting this report
key_terms.عَلِيَّ بْنَ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلس: Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, the subject of the report

ai.seo_question: Did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام have someone slaughter on his behalf?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام had a servant girl who would carry out slaughtering for him when needed. It is cited in the context of hunting and slaughtering, indicating the permissibility of delegated slaughter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4193 - And Ibn al-Mughira narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (as):
"Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) had a servant girl who used to slaughter for him whenever he desired."
